description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmpEmergencyContactService in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing emergency contact related functionalities within the Pim module.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the EmpEmergencyContactService functionalities such as retrieval, saving, deleting, and searching emergency contacts within the OrangeHRM Pim module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the service and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple emergency contacts for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single emergency contact by employee and contact ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving a new emergency contact, verifying that the data is correctly persisted.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests searching for emergency contacts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of emergency contacts matching search criteria.
